types.description: The Quran Education Platform's own economic model (vision A.8): a Waqf Endowment Board stewarding gifts alongside a Not-for-Profit Trust running the platform. FROM A.8 AND NOT ADJUSTABLE BY A ROUND: no owner profit (100% donation and waqf-backed) and a surplus cap of 5% with reinvestment. THE REMAINING THREE PROPORTIONS ARE A DEFAULT INSIDE THOSE CONSTRAINTS, not the Owner's stated figures: the endowment takes the largest retained share because A.8 charges it with perpetual funding, learners are the beneficiaries because the platform is free at the point of use, and the charity share is Zakat-eligible. Virtual WST only.

body.cycle_counts_basis: `operating_cycles` is this roster's own tally; `ledger_cycles` is what the entity's books record. They differ whenever a cycle ran outside the roster.

body.owner_basis: no account exists for this id - nothing has accrued to it, so there is nothing to pay
body.owner_registry_basis: no account exists for this id, so there is no recorded owner to check
body.entries_history_basis: complete: all 0 entries recorded for this account are stored (an account keeps at most 200)
body.note: Virtual/simulated WST only. Real-money payouts are gated until the Owner explicitly authorises real rails AND a compliance/KYC review passes — no real funds move.
body.payout_requests_basis: every Change Control record the payout gate filed for this account; each state is computed from that record when this is read

owner_share_reconciliation.owner_share_is: The owner's share is what the book of record distributed to the owner: the double-entry owner postings (the Owner's ruling of 2026-10-12). The owner account is the record a payout draws on; where it differs from the book of record, the difference is said here and nothing is corrected. The pot is a derived view and holds books older than double entry.
owner_share_reconciliation.basis: There is no ledger for workstation-idbo, so what its owner account accrued (0.00 WST) has no book of record to be checked against. Read only: nothing was accrued or posted to close a difference.

profit_and_loss.total_reserves_wst_basis: cumulative reserve allocations recorded by cycles; excludes transfers out of the fund and period closes
profit_and_loss.reserve_fund_live_wst_basis: the live double-entry reserve_fund balance — what the fund actually holds now

venture_portfolio.funding_basis: recorded, unfunded — the investee is NOT credited. The position is the investor's own record of an allocation; no intake is queued for the named entity and its waterfall never receives this amount. Virtual WST throughout.

charitable_giving.label: allocated (virtual, every grant unassessed)
charitable_giving.basis: the charity pot's balance in virtual WST: allocated, not given - no real money moves here - and each grant carries the compliance screen's verdict, which can refuse a grant and cannot clear one ('review' means unassessed)

organism_posture.composite_health_basis: 0% of this figure's weight is measured (nothing); the rest is an immune term with NO call observed in its window (the absence of failures, not a reading), a self-healing term defaulted to 1.0 and a simulated metabolic term. The measured-only score is None, and that is what decides the mode and every gate.
organism_posture.energy_basis: 1 - 0.0s spent / 3600s stated capacity this window (the capacity is a stated assumption); the work budget is switched off (WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET), so nothing reads this figure: the energy thresholds read the ATP simulator, which cannot fall, and stay inert as ruled

profit_and_loss.net_profit_basis: SURPLUS AFTER WATERFALL DISTRIBUTIONS, not a profit: this chart types every distribution pot (owner, self-investment, capital fund, user projects, charity) as an expense and has no liability account, so retained funds and the Owner's share are counted as spent, and an owner share accrued but unpaid is booked as paid (the payable is in owner payments). operating_result_before_distributions_wst is the figure before the waterfall.

cash_flow.scope: postings that touch the `cash` account only
cash_flow.basis: receipts are postings DEBITING `cash` and payments are postings CREDITING it, so this is movement through one account and not a statement about the enterprise's whole cash position. The cycle's compat postings route their amounts through `cash` in equal and opposite totals, so net_cash_movement_wst is ZERO BY CONSTRUCTION on any period built from them — a zero here is not a finding that cash in matched cash out. Inter-VSB transfers and reserve movements post against `reserve_fund` and are NOT counted here

trial_balance.scope: the double-entry CHART OF ACCOUNTS, summed by normal balance. These totals are not comparable with balances(), which is the seven waterfall pots: an asset-to-asset movement nets to zero here and still shows in a pot, and that is agreement, not divergence

statements.prepared_by: the ledger's own close routine - deterministic arithmetic over the double-entry postings. No C-Suite resource was consulted and no agent reviewed these figures
statements.disclaimer: Virtual/simulated WST units — not real money.

not_stated.basis: written before postings carried a source, or by a caller that states none - these are NOT attributed to any source

by_source.basis: split from each posting's own `source` tag, which names what moved the money. A posting with no tag is counted under `not_stated` and attributed to nothing - the books held no source before this, so an untagged posting is not evidence of any.
